topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 700 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 4 ERC4626 vaults, 62 ERC20 tokens, 8 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 51 common project-authored base contract(s) (admin, hasstate, getters). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
